Thief.text: If this attack was successful and the user is not holding an item, it steals the target's held item. A target with the Sticky Hold Ability does not lose its held item if it has not fainted. The target's item is not stolen if it is a Mega Stone and either the user or the target is the species that can Mega Evolve with it. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.
Thief.serebii: If the user is not already holding an item it steals the target's held item.
Thief.pokebase: If the user has no item, it takes the target's held item.
Thief.smogon: If this attack was successful and the user is not holding an item, it steals the target's held item. A target with the Sticky Hold Ability does not lose its held item if it has not fainted. The target's item is not stolen if it is a Mega Stone and either the user or the target is the species that can Mega Evolve with it. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.

Thrash.text: The user spends two or three turns locked into this move and becomes confused immediately after its move on the last turn of the effect if it is not already. This move targets an opposing Pokemon at random on each turn. If the user is prevented from moving, is asleep at the beginning of a turn, or the attack is not successful against the target on the first turn of the effect or the second turn of a three-turn effect, the effect ends without causing confusion. If this move is called by Sleep Talk and the user is asleep, the move is used for one turn and does not confuse the user.
Thrash.serebii: The user gains the Rampaging status.
Thrash.pokebase: The user attacks for 2 or 3 turns at random opponents, then becomes confused.
Thrash.smogon: The user spends two or three turns locked into this move and becomes confused immediately after its move on the last turn of the effect if it is not already. This move targets an opposing Pokemon at random on each turn. If the user is prevented from moving, is asleep at the beginning of a turn, or the attack is not successful against the target on the first turn of the effect or the second turn of a three-turn effect, the effect ends without causing confusion. If this move is called by Sleep Talk and the user is asleep, the move is used for one turn and does not confuse the user.

Throat Chop.text: For 2 turns, the target cannot use sound-based moves.
Throat Chop.serebii: Gives the target the Throat Chopped status.
Throat Chop.pokebase: For 2 turns, the target can't use sound moves.
Throat Chop.smogon: For 2 turns, the target cannot use sound-based moves.

Thunder.text: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target. This move can hit a target using Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, or is under the effect of Sky Drop. If the weather is Heavy Rain or Rain, this move does not check accuracy. If the weather is Intense Sun or Sun, this move's accuracy is 50%. If this move is used against a Pokemon holding Utility Umbrella, this move's accuracy remains at 70%.
Thunder.serebii: Has a 30% chance of paralyzing the target. This move never misses in rain and can hit a target that has the Sky-High status.
Thunder.pokebase: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target. Never misses in rain; only 50% accurate in harsh sunlight. Hits Pokémon in the air.
Thunder.smogon: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target. This move can hit a target using Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, or is under the effect of Sky Drop. If the weather is Heavy Rain or Rain, this move does not check accuracy. If the weather is Intense Sun or Sun, this move's accuracy is 50%. If this move is used against a Pokemon holding Utility Umbrella, this move's accuracy remains at 70%.

Thunderbolt.text: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target.
Thunderbolt.serebii: Has a 10% chance of paralyzing the target.
Thunderbolt.pokebase: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target.
Thunderbolt.smogon: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target.

Thunder Fang.text: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target and a 10% chance to make it flinch.
Thunder Fang.serebii: Has a 10% chance of paralyzing the target and a 10% chance of making the target flinch.
Thunder Fang.pokebase: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target and a 10% chance to make it flinch.
Thunder Fang.smogon: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target and a 10% chance to make it flinch.

Thunder Punch.text: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target.
Thunder Punch.serebii: Has a 10% chance of paralyzing the target.
Thunder Punch.pokebase: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target.
Thunder Punch.smogon: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target.

Thunder Wave.text: Paralyzes the target. This move does not ignore type immunity.
Thunder Wave.pokebase: Paralyzes the target. Ground and Electric types are unaffected.
Thunder Wave.smogon: Paralyzes the target. This move does not ignore type immunity.

Tickle.text: Lowers the target's Attack and Defense by 1 stage.
Tickle.serebii: Lowers the target's Attack and Defense stats by 1 stage.
Tickle.pokebase: Lowers the target's Attack and Defense by 1 stage each.
Tickle.smogon: Lowers the target's Attack and Defense by 1 stage.

Tidy Up.text: Raises the user's Attack and Speed by 1 stage. Removes substitutes from all active Pokemon and ends the effects of Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, and Toxic Spikes for both sides.
Tidy Up.serebii: Removes the Sticky Web Stealth Rock Substitute Spikes and Toxic Spikes statuses from the entire field. Boosts the user's Attack and Speed stats by 1 stage.
Tidy Up.pokebase: Raises the user's Attack and Speed by 1 stage each, and clears entry hazards and Substitutes from both sides.
Tidy Up.smogon: Raises the user's Attack and Speed by 1 stage. Removes substitutes from all active Pokemon and ends the effects of Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, and Toxic Spikes for both sides.

Topsy-Turvy.text: The target's positive stat stages become negative and vice versa. Fails if all of the target's stat stages are 0.
Topsy-Turvy.serebii: Inverts all stat changes affecting the target.
Topsy-Turvy.pokebase: Reverses the target's stat changes: raised stats become lowered and the other way round.
Topsy-Turvy.smogon: The target's positive stat stages become negative and vice versa. Fails if all of the target's stat stages are 0.

Torch Song.text: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Special Attack by 1 stage.
Torch Song.serebii: Boosts the user's Sp. Atk stat by 1 stage.
Torch Song.pokebase: Always raises the user's Sp. Atk by 1 stage.
Torch Song.smogon: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Special Attack by 1 stage.

Torment.text: Prevents the target from selecting the same move for use two turns in a row. This effect ends when the target is no longer active.
Torment.serebii: Gives the target the Unable to Repeat status.
Torment.pokebase: The target can't use the same move two turns in a row while it stays in battle.
Torment.smogon: Prevents the target from selecting the same move for use two turns in a row. This effect ends when the target is no longer active.

Toxic.text: Badly poisons the target. If a Poison-type Pokemon uses this move, the target cannot avoid the attack, even if the target is in the middle of a two-turn move.
Toxic.serebii: Badly poisons the target. If the user is a Poison type this move will never miss.
Toxic.pokebase: Badly poisons the target. Never misses when a Poison type uses it.
Toxic.smogon: Badly poisons the target. If a Poison-type Pokemon uses this move, the target cannot avoid the attack, even if the target is in the middle of a two-turn move.

Toxic Spikes.text: Sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, poisoning each opposing Pokemon that switches in, unless it is a Flying-type Pokemon or has the Levitate Ability. Can be used up to two times before failing. Opposing Pokemon become poisoned with one layer and badly poisoned with two layers. Can be removed from the opposing side if any Pokemon uses Tidy Up, or if any opposing Pokemon uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Defog successfully, is hit by Defog, or a grounded Poison-type Pokemon switches in. Safeguard prevents the opposing party from being poisoned on switch-in, but a substitute does not.
Toxic Spikes.serebii: Gives the opponent's side the Toxic Spikes status.
Toxic Spikes.pokebase: Lays poison spikes on the opposing side that poison grounded Pokémon as they switch in. Two layers badly poison.
Toxic Spikes.smogon: Sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, poisoning each opposing Pokemon that switches in, unless it is a Flying-type Pokemon or has the Levitate Ability. Can be used up to two times before failing. Opposing Pokemon become poisoned with one layer and badly poisoned with two layers. Can be removed from the opposing side if any Pokemon uses Tidy Up, or if any opposing Pokemon uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Defog successfully, is hit by Defog, or a grounded Poison-type Pokemon switches in. Safeguard prevents the opposing party from being poisoned on switch-in, but a substitute does not.

Toxic Thread.text: Lowers the target's Speed by 2 stages and poisons it.
Toxic Thread.serebii: Lowers the target's Speed stat by 2 stages and poisons it.
Toxic Thread.pokebase: Poisons the target and lowers its Speed by 2 stages.
Toxic Thread.smogon: Lowers the target's Speed by 2 stages and poisons it.

Trailblaze.text: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1 stage.
Trailblaze.serebii: Boosts the user's Speed stat by 1 stage.
Trailblaze.pokebase: Always raises the user's Speed by 1 stage.
Trailblaze.smogon: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1 stage.

Transform.text: The user transforms into the target. The target's current stats, stat stages, types, moves, Ability, weight, gender, and sprite are copied. The user's level and HP remain the same and each copied move receives only 5 PP, with a maximum of 5 PP each. The user can no longer change formes if it would have the ability to do so. This move fails if it hits a substitute, if either the user or the target is already transformed, or if either is behind an Illusion.
Transform.serebii: The user transforms into a copy of the target. It also copies all of the target's stats apart from its HP.
Transform.pokebase: The user becomes a copy of the target: its stats, stat changes, types, Ability and moves.
Transform.smogon: The user transforms into the target. The target's current stats, stat stages, types, moves, Ability, weight, gender, and sprite are copied. The user's level and HP remain the same and each copied move receives only 5 PP, with a maximum of 5 PP each. The user can no longer change formes if it would have the ability to do so. This move fails if it hits a substitute, if either the user or the target is already transformed, or if either is behind an Illusion.

Tri Attack.text: Has a 20% chance to either burn, freeze, or paralyze the target.
Tri Attack.serebii: Has a 20% chance of leaving the target burned frozen or paralyzed.
Tri Attack.pokebase: Has a 20% chance to burn, freeze or paralyze the target, one at random.
Tri Attack.smogon: Has a 20% chance to either burn, freeze, or paralyze the target.

Trick-or-Treat.text: Causes the Ghost type to be added to the target, effectively making it have two or three types. Fails if the target is already a Ghost type. If Forest's Curse adds a type to the target, it replaces the type added by this move and vice versa.
Trick-or-Treat.serebii: Gives the target the Trick-or-Treating status.
Trick-or-Treat.pokebase: Adds Ghost to the target's types.
Trick-or-Treat.smogon: Causes the Ghost type to be added to the target, effectively making it have two or three types. Fails if the target is already a Ghost type. If Forest's Curse adds a type to the target, it replaces the type added by this move and vice versa.

Trick.text: The user swaps its held item with the target's held item. Fails if both the user and the target have no held item, or if the user is trying to give or take a Mega Stone to or from the species that can Mega Evolve with it. The target is immune to this move if it has the Sticky Hold Ability.
Trick.serebii: The user and the target swap their held items.
Trick.pokebase: Swaps held items with the target.
Trick.smogon: The user swaps its held item with the target's held item. Fails if both the user and the target have no held item, or if the user is trying to give or take a Mega Stone to or from the species that can Mega Evolve with it. The target is immune to this move if it has the Sticky Hold Ability.

Trick Room.text: For 5 turns, the Speed of every Pokemon is recalculated for the purposes of determining turn order. During the effect, each Pokemon's Speed is considered to be (10000 - its normal Speed), and if this value is greater than 8191, 8192 is subtracted from it. If this move is used during the effect, the effect ends.
Trick Room.serebii: Gives the entire field the Trick Room status for 5 turns.
Trick Room.pokebase: Goes last (−7 priority). For 5 turns, slower Pokémon move before faster ones; using it again while it's up ends it.
Trick Room.smogon: For 5 turns, the Speed of every Pokemon is recalculated for the purposes of determining turn order. During the effect, each Pokemon's Speed is considered to be (10000 - its normal Speed), and if this value is greater than 8191, 8192 is subtracted from it. If this move is used during the effect, the effect ends.

Triple Arrows.text: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage, a 30% chance to make it flinch, and a higher chance for a critical hit (12.5%, against 4.17% for a normal move).
Triple Arrows.serebii: Has a 50% chance of lowering the target's Defense stat by 1 stage and has a 30% chance of making the target flinch. This move has a 1-stage Critical-Hit Ratio Boost.
Triple Arrows.pokebase: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage and a 30% chance to make it flinch. Lands a critical hit 1 time in 8.
Triple Arrows.smogon: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage, a 30% chance to make it flinch, and a higher chance for a critical hit.

Triple Axel.text: Hits three times. Power increases to 40 for the second hit and 60 for the third. This move checks accuracy for each hit, and the attack ends if the target avoids a hit. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit three times.
Triple Axel.serebii: The user attacks 3 times in a row—first with a power of 20 then with a power of 40 then with a power of 60. The attack ends if the user misses.
Triple Axel.pokebase: Kicks up to 3 times, with 20, 40 and 60 power. Each kick checks accuracy, and it stops at the first miss.
Triple Axel.smogon: Hits three times. Power increases to 40 for the second hit and 60 for the third. This move checks accuracy for each hit, and the attack ends if the target avoids a hit. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit three times.

Trop Kick.text: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.
Trop Kick.serebii: Lowers the target's Attack stat by 1 stage.
Trop Kick.pokebase: Always lowers the target's Attack by 1 stage.
Trop Kick.smogon: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.

Twin Beam.text: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.
Twin Beam.serebii: The user attacks twice in a row.
Twin Beam.smogon: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.

U-turn.text: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members, or if the target switched out using an Eject Button or through the effect of the Emergency Exit or Wimp Out Abilities.
U-turn.serebii: After attacking the user switches out of battle to be replaced by another party Pokémon.
U-turn.pokebase: After it hits, the user switches out.
U-turn.smogon: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members, or if the target switched out using an Eject Button or through the effect of the Emergency Exit or Wimp Out Abilities.

Upper Hand.text: Has a 100% chance to make the target flinch. Fails if the target did not select a physical or special attack for use this turn with altered priority greater than 0, or if the target moves before the user.
Upper Hand.serebii: Makes the target flinch. This move fails if the target isn't about to use a priority move.
Upper Hand.pokebase: Goes before most moves (+3 priority) and makes the target flinch, but fails unless the target is about to use a priority attack.
Upper Hand.smogon: Has a 100% chance to make the target flinch. Fails if the target did not select a physical or special attack for use this turn with altered priority greater than 0, or if the target moves before the user.

Uproar.text: The user spends three turns locked into this move. This move targets an opponent at random on each turn. On the first of the three turns, all sleeping active Pokemon wake up. During the three turns, no active Pokemon can fall asleep by any means, and Pokemon switched in during the effect do not wake up. If the user is prevented from moving or the attack is not successful against the target during one of the turns, the effect ends.
Uproar.serebii: The user gains the Uproar status.
Uproar.pokebase: The user attacks for 3 turns at random opponents. Meanwhile no Pokémon can fall asleep, and sleeping ones wake up.
Uproar.smogon: The user spends three turns locked into this move. This move targets an opponent at random on each turn. On the first of the three turns, all sleeping active Pokemon wake up. During the three turns, no active Pokemon can fall asleep by any means, and Pokemon switched in during the effect do not wake up. If the user is prevented from moving or the attack is not successful against the target during one of the turns, the effect ends.

Vacuum Wave.pokebase: Usually goes first (+1 priority). Deals damage with no added effect.

Venoshock.text: Power doubles if the target is poisoned.
Venoshock.serebii: This move's power is doubled if the target is poisoned or badly poisoned.
Venoshock.pokebase: Power doubles to 130 if the target is poisoned.
Venoshock.smogon: Power doubles if the target is poisoned.

Volt Switch.text: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members, or if the target switched out using an Eject Button or through the effect of the Emergency Exit or Wimp Out Abilities.
Volt Switch.serebii: After attacking the user switches out of battle to be replaced by another party Pokémon.
Volt Switch.pokebase: After it hits, the user switches out.
Volt Switch.smogon: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members, or if the target switched out using an Eject Button or through the effect of the Emergency Exit or Wimp Out Abilities.

Volt Tackle.text: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target. If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.
Volt Tackle.serebii: Has a 10% chance of paralyzing the target. The user also takes 1/3 of the damage dealt by this move.
Volt Tackle.pokebase: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target. The user takes recoil damage equal to 1/3 of the damage it deals.
Volt Tackle.smogon: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target. If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

Waterfall.text: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch.
Waterfall.serebii: Has a 20% chance of making the target flinch.
Waterfall.pokebase: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch.
Waterfall.smogon: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch.

Water Pulse.text: Has a 20% chance to confuse the target.
Water Pulse.serebii: Has a 20% chance of confusing the target.
Water Pulse.pokebase: Has a 20% chance to confuse the target.
Water Pulse.smogon: Has a 20% chance to confuse the target.

Water Shuriken.text: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is an Ash-Greninja with the Battle Bond Ability, this move has a power of 20 and always hits three times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.
Water Shuriken.serebii: The user attacks 2 to 5 times in a row.
Water Shuriken.pokebase: Usually goes first (+1 priority). Hits 2 to 5 times in a row.
Water Shuriken.smogon: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is an Ash-Greninja with the Battle Bond Ability, this move has a power of 20 and always hits three times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.

Water Spout.text: Power is equal to (user's current HP × 150 / user's maximum HP), rounded down, but not less than 1.
Water Spout.serebii: The less HP the user has left the lower this move's power (ranging between 1 and 150).
Water Spout.pokebase: Hits both opposing Pokémon. The lower the user's HP, the weaker it gets: 150 power at full HP.
Water Spout.smogon: Power is equal to (user's current HP × 150 / user's maximum HP), rounded down, but not less than 1.

Wave Crash.text: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.
Wave Crash.serebii: The user takes 1/3 of the damage dealt by this move.
Wave Crash.pokebase: The user takes recoil damage equal to 1/3 of the damage it deals.
Wave Crash.smogon: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

Weather Ball.text: Power doubles if a weather condition other than Strong Winds is active, and this move's type changes to match. Ice type during Snow, Water type during Heavy Rain or Rain, Rock type during Sandstorm, and Fire type during Intense Sun or Sun. If the user is holding Utility Umbrella and uses Weather Ball during Heavy Rain, Rain, Intense Sun, or Sun, this move remains Normal type and does not double in power.
Weather Ball.serebii: When a weather condition is present this move's power is doubled and its type changes. Harsh sunlight Fire type. Rain Water type. Snow Ice type. Sandstorm Rock type.
Weather Ball.pokebase: In weather, its power doubles to 100 and it changes type: Fire in sun, Water in rain, Ice in snow, Rock in a sandstorm.
Weather Ball.smogon: Power doubles if a weather condition other than Strong Winds is active, and this move's type changes to match. Ice type during Snow, Water type during Heavy Rain or Rain, Rock type during Sandstorm, and Fire type during Intense Sun or Sun. If the user is holding Utility Umbrella and uses Weather Ball during Heavy Rain, Rain, Intense Sun, or Sun, this move remains Normal type and does not double in power.

Whirlpool.text: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.
Whirlpool.serebii: Gives the target the Bound status. This move's power is doubled if the target has the Submerged status.
Whirlpool.pokebase: Traps the target for 4 or 5 turns, damaging it by 1/8 of its max HP at the end of each turn.
Whirlpool.smogon: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.

Whirlwind.text: The target is forced to switch out and be replaced with a random unfainted ally. Fails if the target is the last unfainted Pokemon in its party, or if the target used Ingrain previously or has the Suction Cups Ability.
Whirlwind.serebii: If there are other Pokémon in the target's party that can switch into battle the target is forced to switch out of battle and is replaced by one of those Pokémon at random.
Whirlwind.pokebase: Goes last (−6 priority). Forces the target out, replacing it with a random Pokémon from its party.
Whirlwind.smogon: The target is forced to switch out and be replaced with a random unfainted ally. Fails if the target is the last unfainted Pokemon in its party, or if the target used Ingrain previously or has the Suction Cups Ability.

Wide Guard.text: The user and its party members are protected from moves made by other Pokemon, including allies, during this turn that target all adjacent foes or all adjacent Pokemon. This move modifies the same 1/X chance of being successful used by other protection moves, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used, but does not use the chance to check for failure. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn or if this move is already in effect for the user's side.
Wide Guard.serebii: During the turn this move is used the user protects its side from moves that target all allies.
Wide Guard.pokebase: Goes before ordinary moves (+3 priority) and protects the user's side from moves that hit more than one Pokémon this turn.
Wide Guard.smogon: The user and its party members are protected from moves made by other Pokemon, including allies, during this turn that target all adjacent foes or all adjacent Pokemon. This move modifies the same 1/X chance of being successful used by other protection moves, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used, but does not use the chance to check for failure. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn or if this move is already in effect for the user's side.

Wild Charge.text: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 1/4 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.
Wild Charge.serebii: The user takes 1/4 of the damage dealt by this move.
Wild Charge.pokebase: The user takes recoil damage equal to 1/4 of the damage it deals.
Wild Charge.smogon: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 1/4 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

Will-O-Wisp.pokebase: Burns the target. Hits 85% of the time.

Wish.text: At the end of the next turn, the Pokemon at the user's position has 1/2 of the user's maximum HP restored to it, rounded down. Fails if this move is already in effect for the user's position.
Wish.serebii: Gives the user's spot the Wish status.
Wish.pokebase: At the end of the next turn, restores half of the user's max HP to whoever is in its spot.
Wish.smogon: At the end of the next turn, the Pokemon at the user's position has 1/2 of the user's maximum HP restored to it, rounded down. Fails if this move is already in effect for the user's position.

Wonder Room.text: For 5 turns, all active Pokemon have their Defense and Special Defense stats swapped. Stat stage changes are unaffected. If this move is used during the effect, the effect ends.
Wonder Room.serebii: Gives the entire field the Wonder Room status for 5 turns.
Wonder Room.pokebase: For 5 turns, every Pokémon's Defense and Sp. Def are swapped. Using it again while it's up ends it.
Wonder Room.smogon: For 5 turns, all active Pokemon have their Defense and Special Defense stats swapped. Stat stage changes are unaffected. If this move is used during the effect, the effect ends.

Wood Hammer.text: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.
Wood Hammer.serebii: The user takes 1/3 of the damage dealt by this move.
Wood Hammer.pokebase: The user takes recoil damage equal to 1/3 of the damage it deals.
Wood Hammer.smogon: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

Worry Seed.text: Causes the target's Ability to become Insomnia. Fails if the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Insomnia, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Truant, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.

Wrap.text: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Mirror Armor.smogon: When one of this Pokemon's stat stages would be lowered by another Pokemon, that Pokemon's stat stage is lowered instead. This effect does not happen if this Pokemon's stat stage was already -6. If the other Pokemon has a substitute, neither Pokemon has its stat stage lowered.

The Abilities that can be negated are Armor Tail, Aroma Veil, Aura Break, Battle Armor, Big Pecks, Bulletproof, Clear Body, Contrary, Damp, Dazzling, Disguise, Dry Skin, Earth Eater, Filter, Flash Fire, Flower Gift, Flower Veil, Fluffy, Friend Guard, Fur Coat, Good as Gold, Grass Pelt, Guard Dog, Heatproof, Heavy Metal, Hyper Cutter, Ice Face, Ice Scales, Illuminate, Immunity, Inner Focus, Insomnia, Keen Eye, Leaf Guard, Levitate, Light Metal, Lightning Rod, Limber, Magic Bounce, Magma Armor, Marvel Scale, Mind's Eye, Mirror Armor, Motor Drive, Multiscale, Oblivious, Overcoat, Own Tempo, Pastel Veil, Punk Rock, Purifying Salt, Queenly Majesty, Sand Veil, Sap Sipper, Shell Armor, Shield Dust, Simple, Snow Cloak, Solid Rock, Soundproof, Sticky Hold, Storm Drain, Sturdy, Suction Cups, Sweet Veil, Tangled Feet, Telepathy, Tera Shell, Thermal Exchange, Thick Fat, Unaware, Vital Spirit, Volt Absorb, Water Absorb, Water Bubble, Water Veil, Well-Baked Body, White Smoke, Wind Rider, Wonder Guard, and Wonder Skin. This affects every other Pokemon on the field, whether or not it is a target of this Pokemon's move, and whether or not their Ability is beneficial to this Pokemon.
Mold Breaker.serebii: The Pokémon's moves are not affected by foe’s abilities during battle
Mold Breaker.pokebase: The Pokémon's moves are not affected by foe’s abilities during battle
Mold Breaker.smogon: This Pokemon's moves and their effects ignore certain Abilities of other Pokemon. The Abilities that can be negated are Armor Tail, Aroma Veil, Aura Break, Battle Armor, Big Pecks, Bulletproof, Clear Body, Contrary, Damp, Dazzling, Disguise, Dry Skin, Earth Eater, Filter, Flash Fire, Flower Gift, Flower Veil, Fluffy, Friend Guard, Fur Coat, Good as Gold, Grass Pelt, Guard Dog, Heatproof, Heavy Metal, Hyper Cutter, Ice Face, Ice Scales, Illuminate, Immunity, Inner Focus, Insomnia, Keen Eye, Leaf Guard, Levitate, Light Metal, Lightning Rod, Limber, Magic Bounce, Magma Armor, Marvel Scale, Mind's Eye, Mirror Armor, Motor Drive, Multiscale, Oblivious, Overcoat, Own Tempo, Pastel Veil, Punk Rock, Purifying Salt, Queenly Majesty, Sand Veil, Sap Sipper, Shell Armor, Shield Dust, Simple, Snow Cloak, Solid Rock, Soundproof, Sticky Hold, Storm Drain, Sturdy, Suction Cups, Sweet Veil, Tangled Feet, Telepathy, Tera Shell, Thermal Exchange, Thick Fat, Unaware, Vital Spirit, Volt Absorb, Water Absorb, Water Bubble, Water Veil, Well-Baked Body, White Smoke, Wind Rider, Wonder Guard, and Wonder Skin. This affects every other Pokemon on the field, whether or not it is a target of this Pokemon's move, and whether or not their Ability is beneficial to this Pokemon.

Moody.text: This Pokemon has a random stat, other than accuracy or evasiveness, raised by 2 stages and another stat lowered by 1 stage at the end of each turn.
Moody.serebii: At the end of every turn, a random stat (except Accuracy and Evasion) is raised by two stages while another is lowered by one stage.
Moody.pokebase: Every turn, one of the Pokémon's stats will be boosted sharply but another stat will be lowered.
Moody.smogon: This Pokemon has a random stat, other than accuracy or evasiveness, raised by 2 stages and another stat lowered by 1 stage at the end of each turn.

Motor Drive.text: This Pokemon is immune to Electric-type moves and raises its Speed by 1 stage when hit by an Electric-type move.
Motor Drive.serebii: The Pokémon takes no damage from Electric-type attacks and Speed raises by one level.
Motor Drive.pokebase: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Electric-type moves. Instead, its Speed stat is boosted.
Motor Drive.smogon: This Pokemon is immune to Electric-type moves and raises its Speed by 1 stage when hit by an Electric-type move.

Moxie.text: This Pokemon's Attack is raised by 1 stage if it attacks and knocks out another Pokemon.
Moxie.serebii: Attack is raised by one stage when the Pokémon knocks out another Pokémon
Moxie.pokebase: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it shows moxie, which boosts its Attack stat.
Moxie.smogon: This Pokemon's Attack is raised by 1 stage if it attacks and knocks out another Pokemon.

Multiscale.text: If this Pokemon is at full HP, damage taken from attacks is halved.
Multiscale.serebii: Reduces damage afflicted to the Pokémon by 50% if at maximum HP
Multiscale.pokebase: Reduces damage afflicted to the Pokémon by 50% if at maximum HP
Multiscale.smogon: If this Pokemon is at full HP, damage taken from attacks is halved.

Mummy.text: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon have their Ability changed to Mummy. Does not affect Pokemon with the As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Mummy, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero Abilities.
Mummy.serebii: Contact with the Pokémon changes the attacker's Ability to Mummy.
Mummy.pokebase: Contact with the Pokémon changes the attacker’s Ability to Mummy.
Mummy.smogon: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon have their Ability changed to Mummy. Does not affect Pokemon with the As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Mummy, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero Abilities.

Natural Cure.text: This Pokemon has its non-volatile status condition cured when it switches out.
Natural Cure.serebii: The Pokémon’s status (BURN, PARALYZE, SLEEP, POISON, FREEZE) is healed when withdrawn from battle.
Natural Cure.pokebase: The Pokémon's status conditions are cured when it switches out.
Natural Cure.smogon: This Pokemon has its non-volatile status condition cured when it switches out.

No Guard.text: Every move used by or against this Pokemon will always hit.
No Guard.serebii: The accuracy of all moves known by this Pokémon and all Pokémon targeting this Pokémon raises to 100%
No Guard.pokebase: The accuracy of all moves known by this Pokémon and all Pokémon targeting this Pokémon raises to 100%
No Guard.smogon: Every move used by or against this Pokemon will always hit.

Oblivious.text: This Pokemon cannot be infatuated or taunted. Gaining this Ability while infatuated or taunted cures it. This Pokemon is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability.
Oblivious.serebii: The Pokémon cannot be under the Attract condition, Intimidated, or be taunted, while having this ability.
Oblivious.pokebase: The Pokémon is oblivious, keeping it from being infatuated, falling for taunts, or being affected by Intimidate.
Oblivious.smogon: This Pokemon cannot be infatuated or taunted. Gaining this Ability while infatuated or taunted cures it. This Pokemon is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability.

Opportunist.text: When an opposing Pokemon has a stat stage raised, this Pokemon copies the effect.
Opportunist.serebii: If an opponent's stat is boosted, the Pokémon seizes the opportunity to boost the same stat for itself.
Opportunist.pokebase: If an opponent's stat is boosted, the Pokémon seizes the opportunity to boost the same stat for itself.
Opportunist.smogon: When an opposing Pokemon has a stat stage raised, this Pokemon copies the effect.

Overcoat.text: This Pokemon is immune to powder moves, damage from Sandstorm, and the effects of Rage Powder and the Effect Spore Ability.
Overcoat.serebii: Protects Pokémon from Weather Effects and Powder moves such as Sleep Powder, Poison Powder etc.
Overcoat.pokebase: The Pokémon takes no damage from sandstorms. It is also protected from the effects of powders and spores.
Overcoat.smogon: This Pokemon is immune to powder moves, damage from Sandstorm, and the effects of Rage Powder and the Effect Spore Ability.

Overgrow.text: When this Pokemon has 1/3 or less of its maximum HP, rounded down, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Grass-type attack.
Overgrow.serebii: When HP is below 1/3rd its maximum, power of Grass-type moves is increased by 50%.
Overgrow.pokebase: Powers up Grass-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.
Overgrow.smogon: When this Pokemon has 1/3 or less of its maximum HP, rounded down, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Grass-type attack.

Own Tempo.text: This Pokemon cannot be confused. Gaining this Ability while confused cures it. This Pokemon is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability.
Own Tempo.serebii: The Pokémon cannot be Confused while having this ability. Blocks Intimidate
Own Tempo.pokebase: The Pokémon sticks to its own tempo, preventing it from becoming confused or being affected by Intimidate.
Own Tempo.smogon: This Pokemon cannot be confused. Gaining this Ability while confused cures it. This Pokemon is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability.

Parental Bond.text: This Pokemon's damaging moves become multi-hit moves that hit twice. The second hit has its damage quartered. Does not affect Doom Desire, Dragon Darts, Dynamax Cannon, Endeavor, Explosion, Final Gambit, Fling, Future Sight, Ice Ball, Rollout, Self-Destruct, any multi-hit move, any move that has multiple targets, or any two-turn move.
Parental Bond.serebii: Every move used by the Pokémon will hit twice. The damage inflicted by the second hit is reduced to 25%. If the move used is a damaging move, each hit is capable of afflicting Secondary Effects and Critical Hits
Parental Bond.smogon: This Pokemon's damaging moves become multi-hit moves that hit twice. The second hit has its damage quartered. Does not affect Doom Desire, Dragon Darts, Dynamax Cannon, Endeavor, Explosion, Final Gambit, Fling, Future Sight, Ice Ball, Rollout, Self-Destruct, any multi-hit move, any move that has multiple targets, or any two-turn move.

Pickpocket.text: If this Pokemon has no item and is hit by a contact move, it steals the attacker's item. This effect applies after all hits from a multi-hit move. This effect is prevented if the move had a secondary effect removed by the Sheer Force Ability.
Pickpocket.serebii: When a Pokémon makes physical contact with the Pokémon, the item of the opponent is stolen.
Pickpocket.pokebase: The Pokémon steals the held item from attackers that made direct contact with it.
Pickpocket.smogon: If this Pokemon has no item and is hit by a contact move, it steals the attacker's item. This effect applies after all hits from a multi-hit move. This effect is prevented if the move had a secondary effect removed by the Sheer Force Ability.

Pickup.text: At the end of each turn, if this Pokemon is not holding an item and at least one adjacent Pokemon used an item during this turn, one of those Pokemon is selected at random and this Pokemon obtains that Pokemon's last used item. An item is not considered the last used if it was a popped Air Balloon, if the item was picked up by another Pokemon with this Ability, or if the item was lost to Bug Bite, Corrosive Gas, Covet, Incinerate, Knock Off, Pluck, or Thief. Items thrown with Fling can be picked up.
Pickup.serebii: Has a 10% chance of finding and holding an item after battle. Will not work if this Pokémon is already holding an item. From Black & White, it allows for the user to pick up the item of its opponent or ally if they used up the item in battle.
Pickup.pokebase: The Pokémon may pick up an item another Pokémon used during a battle. It may pick up items outside of battle, too.
Pickup.smogon: At the end of each turn, if this Pokemon is not holding an item and at least one adjacent Pokemon used an item during this turn, one of those Pokemon is selected at random and this Pokemon obtains that Pokemon's last used item. An item is not considered the last used if it was a popped Air Balloon, if the item was picked up by another Pokemon with this Ability, or if the item was lost to Bug Bite, Corrosive Gas, Covet, Incinerate, Knock Off, Pluck, or Thief. Items thrown with Fling can be picked up.

Piercing Drill.text: This Pokemon's contact moves ignore a target's protection and deal 1/4 the usual damage.
Piercing Drill.serebii: When the Pokémon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves, dealing 1/4 of the damage that the move would otherwise deal. Everything aside from the target's protective effects is still triggered.
Piercing Drill.pokebase: When the Pokémon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves, dealing 1/4 of the damage that the move would otherwise deal. Everything aside from the target's protective effects is still triggered.
Piercing Drill.smogon: This Pokemon's contact moves ignore a target's protection and deal 1/4 the usual damage.

Pixilate.text: This Pokemon's Normal-type moves become Fairy-type moves and have their power multiplied by 1.2. This effect comes after other effects that change a move's type, but before Ion Deluge and Electrify's effects.
Pixilate.serebii: Increases the power of Normal-type moves by 20%. It then changes those moves to Fairy-type.
Pixilate.pokebase: Normal-type moves become Fairy-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.
Pixilate.smogon: This Pokemon's Normal-type moves become Fairy-type moves and have their power multiplied by 1.2. This effect comes after other effects that change a move's type, but before Ion Deluge and Electrify's effects.

Plus.text: If an active ally has this Ability or the Minus Ability, this Pokemon's Special Attack is multiplied by 1.5.
Plus.serebii: When battling with Plus or Minus, Special Attack increases by 50%.
Plus.pokebase: Boosts the Sp. Atk stat of the Pokémon if an ally with the Plus or Minus Ability is also in battle.
Plus.smogon: If an active ally has this Ability or the Minus Ability, this Pokemon's Special Attack is multiplied by 1.5.

Poison Heal.text: If this Pokemon is poisoned, it restores 1/8 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn instead of losing HP.
Poison Heal.serebii: HP is restored by 1/8th the maximum HP every turn while the Pokémon has the Poison condition.
Poison Heal.pokebase: If poisoned, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.
Poison Heal.smogon: If this Pokemon is poisoned, it restores 1/8 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn instead of losing HP.

Poison Point.text: 30% chance a Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon will be poisoned.
Poison Point.serebii: The opponent has a 30% chance of being induced with Poison when using an attack, that requires physical contact, against this Pokémon.
Poison Point.pokebase: Contact with the Pokémon may poison the attacker.
Poison Point.smogon: 30% chance a Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon will be poisoned.

Poison Touch.text: This Pokemon's contact moves have a 30% chance of poisoning. This effect comes after a move's inherent secondary effect chance.
Poison Touch.serebii: When the Pokémon attacks its opponents with a move that causes Physical Contact, there is a 30% chance that the target is Poisoned.
Poison Touch.pokebase: May poison a target when the Pokémon makes contact.
Poison Touch.smogon: This Pokemon's contact moves have a 30% chance of poisoning. This effect comes after a move's inherent secondary effect chance.

Prankster.text: This Pokemon's non-damaging moves have their priority increased by 1. Opposing Dark-type Pokemon are immune to these moves, and any move called by these moves, if the resulting user of the move has this Ability.
Prankster.serebii: Status category moves have their Speed Priority increased by 1. Moves increased by this that are used on Dark-type opponents will fail.
Prankster.pokebase: Increases the priority of the Pokémon's status moves by 1 stage. However, the Pokémon's status moves no longer work against Dark-type Pokémon.
Prankster.smogon: This Pokemon's non-damaging moves have their priority increased by 1. Opposing Dark-type Pokemon are immune to these moves, and any move called by these moves, if the resulting user of the move has this Ability.

Pressure.text: If this Pokemon is the target of an opposing Pokemon's move, that move loses one additional PP. Imprison, Snatch, and Tera Blast also lose one additional PP when used by an opposing Pokemon, but Sticky Web does not.
Pressure.serebii: When this Pokémon is hit by a move, the opponent’s PP lowers by 2 rather than 1.
Pressure.pokebase: Puts other Pokémon under pressure, causing them to expend more PP to use their moves.
Pressure.smogon: If this Pokemon is the target of an opposing Pokemon's move, that move loses one additional PP. Imprison, Snatch, and Tera Blast also lose one additional PP when used by an opposing Pokemon, but Sticky Web does not.

Protean.text: This Pokemon's type changes to match the type of the move it is about to use. This effect comes after all effects that change a move's type. This effect can only happen once per switch-in, and only if this Pokemon is not Terastallized.
Protean.serebii: Before the Pokémon uses a move, it becomes a pure Pokémon of that type. This only works once per switch in.
Protean.pokebase: Before the Pokémon uses a move, it becomes a pure Pokémon of that type. This only works once per switch in.
Protean.smogon: This Pokemon's type changes to match the type of the move it is about to use. This effect comes after all effects that change a move's type. This effect can only happen once per switch-in, and only if this Pokemon is not Terastallized.

Psychic Surge.text: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Psychic Terrain, for 5 turns.
Psychic Surge.serebii: Activates Psychic Terrain for 5 turns when the Pokémon enters a battle.
Psychic Surge.pokebase: Turns the entire field into Psychic Terrain for 5 turns when the Pokémon enters a battle.
Psychic Surge.smogon: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Psychic Terrain.

Punk Rock.text: This Pokemon's sound-based moves have their power multiplied by 1.3. This Pokemon takes halved damage from sound-based moves.
Punk Rock.serebii: Increases the damage of Sound based moves by 30%. Reduces damage taken by this Pokémon by Sound based moves by 50%.
Punk Rock.pokebase: Boosts the power of the Pokémon's sound-based moves by 30% and halves the damage the Pokémon takes from sound-based moves.
Punk Rock.smogon: This Pokemon's sound-based moves have their power multiplied by 1.3. This Pokemon takes halved damage from sound-based moves.

Pure Power.serebii: The Pokémon’s Attack stat is doubled in battle while having this ability.
Pure Power.pokebase: Using its pure power, the Pokémon doubles its Attack stat.

Purifying Salt.text: This Pokemon cannot become affected by a non-volatile status condition or Yawn. If a Pokemon uses a Ghost-type attack against this Pokemon, that Pokemon's offensive stat is halved when calculating the damage to this Pokemon.
Purifying Salt.serebii: The Pokémon's pure salt protects it from status conditions and halves the damage taken from Ghost-type moves.
Purifying Salt.pokebase: The Pokémon's pure salt protects it from status conditions and halves the damage taken from Ghost-type moves.
Purifying Salt.smogon: This Pokemon cannot become affected by a non-volatile status condition or Yawn. If a Pokemon uses a Ghost-type attack against this Pokemon, that Pokemon's offensive stat is halved when calculating the damage to this Pokemon.

Queenly Majesty.text: Priority moves used by opposing Pokemon targeting this Pokemon or its allies are prevented from having an effect.
Queenly Majesty.serebii: Prevents the opponent from using moves with increased Speed Priority on this Pokémon or its allies.
Queenly Majesty.pokebase: Opponents are unable to use priority moves against the Pokémon or its allies.
Queenly Majesty.smogon: Priority moves used by opposing Pokemon targeting this Pokemon or its allies are prevented from having an effect.

Quick Draw.text: This Pokemon has a 30% chance to move first in its priority bracket with attacking moves.
Quick Draw.serebii: At the start of each turn, this Pokémon has a 30% chance of moving first in the Speed Priority Bracket
Quick Draw.pokebase: Enables the Pokémon to move first occasionally.
Quick Draw.smogon: This Pokemon has a 30% chance to move first in its priority bracket with attacking moves.

Quick Feet.text: If this Pokemon has a non-volatile status condition, its Speed is multiplied by 1.5. This Pokemon ignores the paralysis effect of halving Speed.
Quick Feet.serebii: Speed is increased by 50% when induced with a status (Burn, Poison, Sleep, Frozen & Paralysis). If Paralysed, the speed drop is ignored.
Quick Feet.pokebase: Boosts the Speed stat if the Pokémon has a status condition.
Quick Feet.smogon: If this Pokemon has a non-volatile status condition, its Speed is multiplied by 1.5. This Pokemon ignores the paralysis effect of halving Speed.

Rain Dish.text: If Rain is active, this Pokemon restores 1/16 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn. This effect is prevented if this Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella.
Rain Dish.serebii: If Heavy Rain weather is in effect, recovers 1/16th max Hit Points at the end of the turn.
Rain Dish.pokebase: The Pokémon gradually regains HP in rain.
Rain Dish.smogon: If Rain is active, this Pokemon restores 1/16 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn. This effect is prevented if this Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella.

Rattled.text: This Pokemon's Speed is raised by 1 stage if hit by a Bug-, Dark-, or Ghost-type attack, or if an opposing Pokemon affected this Pokemon with the Intimidate Ability.
Rattled.serebii: Speed is raised by one stage when the Pokémon is hit by a Bug-type, Ghost-type or Dark-type move or is Intimidated
Rattled.pokebase: When the Pokémon takes damage from a Dark-, Ghost-, or Bug-type move or when it is on the receiving end of Intimidate, its Speed stat is boosted by 1 stage.
Rattled.smogon: This Pokemon's Speed is raised by 1 stage if hit by a Bug-, Dark-, or Ghost-type attack, or if an opposing Pokemon affected this Pokemon with the Intimidate Ability.

Receiver.text: This Pokemon copies the Ability of an ally that faints. Abilities that cannot be copied are As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Flower Gift, Forecast, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Trace, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, and Zero to Hero.
Receiver.serebii: The Pokémon copies the Ability of a defeated ally.
Receiver.pokebase: The Pokémon copies the Ability of a defeated ally.
Receiver.smogon: This Pokemon copies the Ability of an ally that faints. Abilities that cannot be copied are As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Flower Gift, Forecast, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Trace, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, and Zero to Hero.

Reckless.text: This Pokemon's attacks with recoil or crash damage have their power multiplied by 1.2. Does not affect Struggle.
Reckless.serebii: The power of moves that have recoil damage is increased by 20%.
Reckless.pokebase: Powers up moves that have recoil damage.
Reckless.smogon: This Pokemon's attacks with recoil or crash damage have their power multiplied by 1.2. Does not affect Struggle.

Refrigerate.text: This Pokemon's Normal-type moves become Ice-type moves and have their power multiplied by 1.2. This effect comes after other effects that change a move's type, but before Ion Deluge and Electrify's effects.
Refrigerate.serebii: Increases the power of Normal-type moves by 20%. It then changes those moves to Ice-type.
Refrigerate.pokebase: Normal-type moves become Ice-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.
Refrigerate.smogon: This Pokemon's Normal-type moves become Ice-type moves and have their power multiplied by 1.2. This effect comes after other effects that change a move's type, but before Ion Deluge and Electrify's effects.

Regenerator.text: This Pokemon restores 1/3 of its maximum HP, rounded down, when it switches out.
Regenerator.serebii: When the Pokémon switches out of battle, up to 33.3% of its maximum Hit Points are restored
Regenerator.pokebase: The Pokémon has a little of its HP restored when withdrawn from battle.
Regenerator.smogon: This Pokemon restores 1/3 of its maximum HP, rounded down, when it switches out.

Ripen.text: When this Pokemon eats certain Berries, the effects are doubled. Berries that restore HP or PP have the amount doubled, Berries that raise stat stages have the amount doubled, Berries that halve damage taken quarter it instead, and a Jaboca Berry or Rowap Berry has the attacker lose 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down.
Ripen.serebii: Ripens Berries and doubles their effect.
Ripen.pokebase: Ripens Berries and doubles their effect.
Ripen.smogon: When this Pokemon eats certain Berries, the effects are doubled. Berries that restore HP or PP have the amount doubled, Berries that raise stat stages have the amount doubled, Berries that halve damage taken quarter it instead, and a Jaboca Berry or Rowap Berry has the attacker lose 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down.

Rivalry.text: This Pokemon's attacks have their power multiplied by 1.25 against targets of the same gender or multiplied by 0.75 against targets of the opposite gender. There is no modifier if either this Pokemon or the target is genderless.
Rivalry.serebii: Attack & Special Attack is increased by 25% if the foe is of the same gender; Attack & Special Attack is decreased by 25% if the foe is of the opposite gender.
Rivalry.pokebase: The Pokémon's competitive spirit makes it deal more damage to Pokémon of the same gender, but less damage to Pokémon of the opposite gender.
Rivalry.smogon: This Pokemon's attacks have their power multiplied by 1.25 against targets of the same gender or multiplied by 0.75 against targets of the opposite gender. There is no modifier if either this Pokemon or the target is genderless.

Rock Head.text: This Pokemon does not take recoil damage, except Struggle. Does not affect Life Orb damage or crash damage.
Rock Head.serebii: Does not receive recoil damage from recoil-causing damages.
Rock Head.pokebase: Protects the Pokémon from recoil damage.
Rock Head.smogon: This Pokemon does not take recoil damage, except Struggle. Does not affect Life Orb damage or crash damage.

Rough Skin.text: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon lose 1/8 of their maximum HP, rounded down.
Rough Skin.serebii: The opponent is hurt by 1/8th of his maxium Hit Points of recoil when using an attack, that requires physical contact, against this Pokémon.
Rough Skin.pokebase: The Pokémon's rough skin damages attackers that make direct contact with it.
Rough Skin.smogon: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon lose 1/8 of their maximum HP, rounded down.

Run Away.serebii: Enables the Pokémon to ignore any effects that would usually prevent it from switching out of battle and being replaced by another party Pokémon.
Run Away.pokebase: Enables the Pokémon to ignore any effects that would usually prevent it from switching out of battle and being replaced by another party Pokémon.

Sand Force.text: If Sandstorm is active, this Pokemon's Ground-, Rock-, and Steel-type attacks have their power multiplied by 1.3. This Pokemon takes no damage from Sandstorm.
Sand Force.serebii: Ground-type, Rock-type & Steel-type moves have their power increased by 30% in a Sandstorm and will not receive damage
Sand Force.pokebase: Boosts the power of Rock-, Ground-, and Steel-type moves in a sandstorm.
Sand Force.smogon: If Sandstorm is active, this Pokemon's Ground-, Rock-, and Steel-type attacks have their power multiplied by 1.3. This Pokemon takes no damage from Sandstorm.

Sand Rush.text: If Sandstorm is active, this Pokemon's Speed is doubled. This Pokemon takes no damage from Sandstorm.
Sand Rush.serebii: Speed is doubled within a sandstorm
Sand Rush.pokebase: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in a sandstorm.
Sand Rush.smogon: If Sandstorm is active, this Pokemon's Speed is doubled. This Pokemon takes no damage from Sandstorm.

Sand Spit.text: When this Pokemon is hit by an attack, the effect of Sandstorm begins.
Sand Spit.serebii: The Pokémon creates a sandstorm when it's hit by an attack.
Sand Spit.pokebase: The Pokémon creates a sandstorm when it's hit by an attack.
Sand Spit.smogon: When this Pokemon is hit by an attack, the effect of Sandstorm begins.

Sand Stream.text: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Sandstorm, for 5 turns.
Sand Stream.serebii: Sandstorm blows when the Pokémon enters battle. As of X & Y, this lasts 5 turns.
Sand Stream.pokebase: The Pokémon summons a sandstorm when it enters a battle.
Sand Stream.smogon: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Sandstorm.

Sand Veil.text: If Sandstorm is active, the accuracy of moves used against this Pokemon is multiplied by 0.8. This Pokemon takes no damage from Sandstorm.
Sand Veil.serebii: Raises the Pokémon’s evasion during a sandstorm by one level.
Sand Veil.pokebase: Boosts the Pokémon's evasiveness by 25% in a sandstorm. The Pokémon takes no damage from sandstorms.
Sand Veil.smogon: If Sandstorm is active, the accuracy of moves used against this Pokemon is multiplied by 0.8. This Pokemon takes no damage from Sandstorm.

Sap Sipper.text: This Pokemon is immune to Grass-type moves and raises its Attack by 1 stage when hit by a Grass-type move.
Sap Sipper.serebii: Attack is raised by one stage when the Pokémon is hit by a Grass-type move. User receives no damage from Grass-type attacks.
Sap Sipper.pokebase: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Grass-type moves. Instead, its Attack stat is boosted.
Sap Sipper.smogon: This Pokemon is immune to Grass-type moves and raises its Attack by 1 stage when hit by a Grass-type move.

Scrappy.text: This Pokemon can hit Ghost types with Normal- and Fighting-type moves. This Pokemon is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability.
Scrappy.serebii: Allows the Pokémon to hit Ghost-type Pokémon with Normal-type and Fighting-type moves. Blocks Intimidate
Scrappy.pokebase: The Pokémon can hit Ghost-type Pokémon with Normal- and Fighting-type moves. It is also unaffected by Intimidate.
Scrappy.smogon: This Pokemon can hit Ghost types with Normal- and Fighting-type moves. This Pokemon is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability.

Screen Cleaner.text: On switch-in, the effects of Aurora Veil, Light Screen, and Reflect end for both sides.
Screen Cleaner.serebii: When the Pokémon enters a battle, the effects of Light Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil are nullified for both opposing and ally Pokémon.
